account_url.description: Account URL associated with platform9 management control plane

password.description: Password for platform9 management control plane

username.description: Username for platform9 management control plane

enabled.description: Indicates whether the addon is enabled (true) or disabled (false)

params.description: A map of configuration parameters specific to the addon

phase.description: Represents the current installation status of the addon, such as Installing or Installed

version.description: Specifies the version of the addon being used

allow_workloads_on_master.description: If the master nodes can run non-critical workloads

batch_upgrade_percent.description: Percentage of nodes to upgrade at a time during a batch upgrade. If this attribute is omitted then nodes will be sequentially upgraded, one after the other.

calico_ip_ip_mode.description: IP-IP encapsulation mode for Calico network. Choose: Always, Never, CrossSubnet

calico_ipv4_detection_method.description: Method to detect the IPv4 address

controller_cpu_limit.description: Corresponds to the CALICO_CONTROLLER_CPU_LIMIT environment variable in Calico.

controller_memory_limit.description: Corresponds to the CALICO_CONTROLLER_MEMORY_LIMIT environment variable in Calico.

node_cpu_limit.description: Corresponds to the CALICO_NODE_CPU_LIMIT environment variable in Calico.

node_memory_limit.description: Corresponds to the CALICO_NODE_MEMORY_LIMIT environment variable in Calico.

typha_cpu_limit.description: Corresponds to the CALICO_TYPHA_CPU_LIMIT environment variable in Calico.

typha_memory_limit.description: Corresponds to the CALICO_TYPHA_MEMORY_LIMIT environment variable in Calico.

calico_nat_outgoing.description: Field is set to true if Calico nodes need to NAT north-south egress traffic.

calico_v4_block_size.description: Subnet size per node for the Calico network, in CIDR notation (e.g. 26)

cert_expiry_hrs.description: Number of hours before user certificates in kubeconfig expires, should be greater than 0 if set

container_runtime.description: Container runtime used by this cluster

containers_cidr.description: CIDR used for pod IP addresses, applicable also for manual deploy

created_at.description: Time at which the cluster was created

enable_catapult_monitoring.description: If set to true platform9 Catapult monitoring will be deployed on the cluster

backup_time.description: Timestamp for daily backup, specified in format 'HH:MM'

max_backups_to_retain.description: Maximum number of backups to retain for timestamped backups.

backup_interval.description: The interval at which etcd backups should be taken, specified in duration strings such as '2h' or '3m'. Note that composite duration strings like '2h3m' are not allowed.

storage_local_path.description: Path on the local filesystem where the etcd backup should be stored. For 'local' storage type only.

storage_type.description: Storage type for the etcd backup. Only 'local' is current supported type. 'local' saves backup to the node's local disk

external_dns_name.description: Optional DNS name for API endpoint. This field is autogenerated when usePf9Domain is set, also applicable for manual deploy

k8s_api_port.description: Port on which the Kubernetes API server is running

api_server_flags.description: List of supported kube-apiserver flags, example: --request-timeout=2m0s,--kubelet-timeout=20s

api_server_runtime_config.description: A set of key=value pairs that enable or disable built-in APIs.

controller_manager_flags.description: List of supported controller manager flags, example: --large-cluster-size-threshold=60,--concurrent-statefulset-syncs=10

scheduler_flags.description: List of supported scheduler flags, example: --kube-api-burst=120,--log_file_max_size=3000

kube_role_version.description: kube role version to be used when bringing up the cluster.

master_nodes.description: List of uuid of master nodes

master_vip_iface.description: If master_vip_ipv4 is specified, this field is required. Specify the interface that the VIP attaches to

master_vip_ipv4.description: API server Virtual IP that provides failover. When specified, deploy keepalived setup to cluster master nodes together

master_vip_vrouter_id.description: Virtual router ID of the master VIP

masterless.description: Field is set to true if the cluster is masterless

mtu_size.description: MTU for container network interfaces. Optional and used for the Calico network backend

network_plugin.description: Network backend to use for container networking. Defaults to flannel. Supported choices are flannel, calico

node_pool_uuid.description: Optional. UUID of the node pool used for the cluster. Defaults to the first node pool of the local cloud provider type

privileged.description: True if cluster runs privileged containers

reserved_cpus.description: Enter a comma separated list of CPUs to be reserved for the system,example:4-8,9-12

services_cidr.description: CIDR used for service IP addresses, applicable also for manual deploy

topology_manager_policy.description: options: none, best-effort, restricted, single-numa-node; default: none

upgrade_kube_role_version.description: Contains the kube role version to which the cluster can be upgraded. If this is null then cluster cannot be upgraded.

use_hostname.description: If set to true nodes will be registered in the cluster using hostname instead of IP address. This option is only applicable to IPv4 hosts.

worker_nodes.description: List of uuid of worker nodes. Required if allow_workloads_on_master is false
